About.title: 🚀 About GreetingAI Studio (PWA)
About.description: GreetingAI Studio is a Progressive Web Application (PWA) that allows users to generate highly personalized AI greeting cards (images and short videos). Select from tailored celebration themes, apply unique artistic visual styles, and personalize your message with custom text or uploaded audio voiceovers. The platform operates on a freemium monetization model, providing 5 free creation credits before requiring a secure Stripe top-up to receive a security key for additional generations.

Form.step1_desc: 💡 Instruction: Click a celebration theme tile (Birthday, Mother's Day, Father's Day, New Year, Valentine's, or Christmas) to load theme samples.
Form.step2_desc: 💡 Instruction: Choose an artistic style tile (Photo, Paint, Picasso, or Video) to set the visual rendering target for the AI engine.
Form.step3_desc: 💡 Instruction: Type your custom message, click quick inspiration templates to auto-fill, or attach an audio voice message.
Form.placeholder_message: Type your custom message or click a quick template above...

Preview.screen_desc: 💡 Instruction: Your synthesized card renders live on this screen. Download the asset directly or share the link with friends.
Preview.screen_text: Your composed AI card will render on this screen
Preview.tray_desc: 💡 Instruction: This gallery holds your 5 most recent card creations, acting as a visual tracker for your 5 free trial credits.
